scope: Independent non-self terminal media-rights proofs, archive retaining history
Explicit CURRENT home-v2 to home-v3 typed content/media/snapshot/review compatibility
Authenticated bounded image/PDF/video private preview and safe unpublished offline QA export
Local native tool/dependency setup, all scoped tests, High checkpoint review and handoff

caps.processing_retry_quota_policy: Retain prior attempts and reserve new worst-case output bytes transactionally before retry; no used-reservation reuse.
caps.private_browser_memory_limit_kind: Logical retained/download byte accounting; transient buffers/decoder/browser RSS not hard-capped; measure and disclose.

dependency_additions.native_ffmpeg_ffprobe: 9.0.2 official signed source local VideoToolbox build; capability gate

rights_policy: READY technical separate PENDING/terminal nonself APPROVED|REJECTED; exact original/derivative/recipe/evidence hashes. No rights revocation extension; archive blocks new selections/submissions but retains old Snapshot proofs/bytes. Factual SOURCE_CHECKED unchanged; uploaded credential not new factual source. No legal certification.
retention_policy: No physical GC in M3; all part/original/quarantine/derivative/orphan bytes retained and charged; unconsumed reservation release only; M4 full backup/restore/cleanup separately approved. Owned per-job scratch intermediates are ephemeral: cleanup allowed after persistent input pins and required evidence; no retained Storage/history deletion.
generated_output_constraints: Owned contained paths only. No application sources/prototype helpers hidden in generated directories, no physical deletion of retained media/history; preserve exact evidence before replacing logs/output. Native builds/downloads audited local only.
